name: Speccy micro / packaging study

sources.verified: ESP32-WROOM-32E envelope 18 x 25.5 x 3.1 mm, dual-core 240 MHz, 4 MB flash variant
LCD carrier footprint 19 x 22.5 mm; active area 15.21 x 15.21 mm; 128 x 128; GC9107; 3.3 V SPI
Manufacturer outline drawing; 22.5 x 19 mm before rotating the assembly
48.26 x 27.94 mm reference PCB dimensions, as indexed in the official drawing; reference only

assumptions: Custom double-sided carrier PCB; mechanical layout only, not routed or electrically validated.
LCD MX1.25 connector is desoldered and replaced with eight short soldered wires to reduce stack height.
LCD Z dimensions and active-area offset are estimated: verify an actual sample before PCB manufacture or case printing.
Switch, Micro-B connector, LDO, passive and screw envelopes are generic package estimates, not vendor CAD models.
USB powers the unit only. External USB-UART programming uses six underside pogo pads (GND, 3V3, TX, RX, EN, BOOT).
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth remain disabled: the display stack does not preserve the full radio antenna clearance.
128 x 96 displayed picture represents a 2:1 reduction of the Spectrum 256 x 192 image; BASIC text will be difficult to read.
Six buttons support game mappings and a menu, not a full Spectrum keyboard.
ROM and one game snapshot live in flash; this size excludes a battery, SD card, speaker and their circuitry.
This is a compact feasible-looking packaging target, not a proven absolute minimum or manufacturing-ready design.
